title: Accessibility of basin-boundary periodic points
exact_target: Can every periodic point on the boundary of such an attracting domain be reached by a curve inside it?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 5300048 (AMR-052-0048). CC BY 4.0.

Feliks Przytycki, ``On Invariant Measures for Iterations of Holomorphic Maps'', in Ben Bielefeld and Mikhail Lyubich (eds.), Problems in Holomorphic Dynamics (1992), Problem 1.1, pp. 29--30; arXiv:math/9205209v1.
